Name: Wallet Items Retexture
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=4][color=#fff2cc]Just a retexture for wallet items to add some freshness and newness to the game (and also make your wallet look more aesthetic).
[/color]
You can enable\disable any sprite through GenericModConfigMenu.

[color=#ff7700][u]I gained some inspiration from Terraria and stock pics from google:[/u]
[/color]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia]Dwarvish Translation Guide to book with rune called 'Odal' (actually upticks on the legs is not correct for this rune, but I added them for book to look more fancier) ;[/font]
[*][font=Georgia]Club Card to Discount Card trinket from Terraria (sized down a bit to fit 16x16 tile);[/font]
[*][font=Georgia]Lucky Charm to Nazar trinket from Terraria (slightly recolored);[/font]
[*][font=Georgia]Dark Talisman to curse mark\rune from Berserk;[/font]
[*][font=Georgia]Key To The Town to lockpicks.[/font]
[/list][/size][/font]
[u][font=Georgia][color=#fff2cc][size=2][center][/center][/size][/color][/font][/u]
